entities.summary: Woljeongsa is Buddhist temple located on the slopes of Odaesan in Pyeongchang County, Gangwon Province, South Korea. It is a head temple of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism. Founded in 643 by the Silla monk Jajang, it is considered a holy site of Manjushri.
